bioconda.name: splitcode
bioconda.summary: Flexible parsing, interpretation, and editing of technical sequences.

biotools.summary: splitcode is a tool for flexible parsing, interpretation, and editing of sequencing reads, facilitating preprocessing of reads from various single-cell and bulk sequencing assays. It is available as a command-line tool with installation through pip and is described in a publication and associated documentation.
